subject: Sponsor measures need two small fields in measure.py scored output
body: Pushed cc20364: autoresearch/research/{probing,realism_nn,contamination}.py (docs/sponsor-measures.md). Two asks for your files, nothing edited by me: (1) Sample.to_dict has no benchmark item id, so contamination analyze can't join scores to items; please add the item id (e.g. 'id') to scored samples. (2) PetriSample.to_dict keeps only the last 1500 chars of the transcript, so probing reads AuditResult rows / the harness cache instead; fine as is, just FYI.
